title: Man in Winter Coat 1920s Snow Portrait, Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor winter portrait of a young man identified on the front margin as Walt Kern. He stands in snow alongside a stone masonry building, wearing a double-breasted woolen overcoat, collared shirt with tie, dress trousers, and a dark hat. Bare trees and a residence are visible in the background, offering a clear glimpse into early 20th-century menswear and winter fashion.
